Author: Jay
Name: Map Click Nav
Description: Hold a modifier (Ctrl by default) and left-click a spot on your current zone's map. Map Click Nav places your flag there, mounts you with Mount Roulette, and has vnavmesh fly you there if flight is unlocked in the zone (or ride there if not). A Stop button appears while traveling. Requires vnavmesh.
Punchline: Ctrl+click the map to travel there with vnavmesh, flying when you can.

Author: Jay
Name: Tank Stance Manager
Description: MT mode keeps tank stance on at all times. OT mode toggles tank stance to hold your enmity inside a configurable band of the main tank's enmity (default 75%-90%), and turns it on if you are pushed to #3. Supports PLD, WAR, DRK, GNB.
Punchline: Keeps tank stance on as MT, or holds an enmity band as OT.
